edits.new: In each direction, first test applicable parent identity or consumer restrictions that the child does not explicitly impose. Apply each restriction to the entity or role it constrains, and construct a concrete case outside it while preserving every child requirement, even if a necessary implication may exclude the case. The justification must identify the restriction and resolve that case. If it is inadmissible or covered, continue testing other parent requirements, prioritizing further qualifications absent from the child's explicit wording before shared conditions. A shared name cannot import the counterpart's definition, and a failed variation does not establish full coverage.
edits.old: For each question, split each parent alternative into its independently required conditions and quote only one condition. If the parent expressly restricts identity or consumer and the child's own meaning does not explicitly impose that restriction, choose it before any shared action, property or purpose condition. Ask which admitted child case concerns someone or something outside that restriction, even if you expect a necessary implication to exclude it. Resolve that starting variation in the answer. If it fails, continue testing other requirements; a final counterexample may violate a different condition. Apply the restriction to what it constrains and retain every permitted topic connection. A failed candidate does not establish complete coverage; the absence of matching explicit wording does not establish a counterexample. When the identity or consumer selection rule does not apply and the parent imposes a further qualification absent from the child's explicit wording, choose that qualification before testing a shared kind or action. Test any necessary ordinary-language implication in the answer; a shared name cannot import the counterpart's definition.

edits.new: Record exactly one open-ended counterexample question per direction: "Which information admitted by [child] falls outside [parent]?" Name both nodes. Conditions may be mentioned in the question. In each answer, give a concrete counterexample satisfying the whole child meaning and escaping every parent alternative and permitted topic connection; otherwise establish that every case in every child alternative satisfies all requirements of at least one covering alternative or connection, or use null if admission, exclusion or necessary coverage remains unresolved. The justification must give the decisive admission/exclusion or complete coverage basis.
edits.old: Record exactly one counterexample question per direction: "Which information admitted by [child] falls outside [parent], starting by testing '[one quoted condition]' in [parent alternative]?" Name both nodes. Construct and resolve a concrete starting variation while preserving every child requirement. If that variation is inadmissible or covered, continue testing other parent conditions and permitted topic connections. A counterexample must satisfy the whole child meaning and escape every parent alternative and permitted topic connection; it need not violate the starting condition. Otherwise, establish that every case in every child alternative satisfies all requirements of at least one covering parent alternative or permitted topic connection. Use null if admission, exclusion or necessary coverage remains unresolved. A failed starting variation alone does not establish full coverage.
